Through the meditation of the water drop and the Īśopaniṣad's Pūrṇam verse, he revealed the completeness of the Lord and how the holy name carries Kṛṣṇa's own presence. He honoured the living example of Jayapatākā Swami and the transmission of wisdom through Prabhupāda's books.

From Mādhavendra Purī as the root of the tree, through Lord Caitanya's own initiation, to the Six Gosvāmīs establishing Vṛndāvana for the world, he revealed that Kṛṣṇa has incarnated in His name as the supreme gift for Kali-yuga.
